paite: Philistia mite'n asepaih tengteng uh Aphek ah akaikhawm vek ua, Israel mite'n Jezreel a tuikhuk kiang ah panmun akhoh uhi,
heading: Philistiate'n David Adeih Kei Uh

paite: Philistia makaite azaza in, asangsang in apai ua, David leh amite'n Akish toh anung uh azui uhi.

Philistia makaite'n, "Hiai Hebrute'n bang ahia ahih uh?" achi uhi. Akish in Philistia makai kiang ah, "Hiai David Israelte kumpipa Saul sikha, hichi tan a ka kiang a om khin a, ka kiang a, ahong lut nung a lah tutan a leng adiklouhna ka muhlouhna pa ahi kei maw?" achi hi.

Himahleh Philistia kumpipate atung ah aheh uhi. Philistia kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Hiai mi na mun sehsak a pai ding in kiksak inla, kidouna ah i kiang uah hong suk kei heh. Huchi lou in zaw kidouna ah i melmate lam ah apang kha ding. Hiai mite lu ding in hiai mipa leh apu kilem nawn ve un teh aw?
Hiai David mah ahi kei maw, Saul in asang asang athat, David in asing asing, chi a, atungtang thu la a asak uh?" achi uhi.

Huchi in Akish in David asam a, akiang ah, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Midik mahmah na hi a, sepaihte lak a ka kiang a na kuan leh na hong leltak ka mitmuh in ahoih mahmah hi. Ka kiang a na hong ni a pan tuni tan in na tung ah bangmah hoihlouhna himhim ka mu het kei hi. Himahleh makaite'n ahon ngai kei uhi.
Huaiziak in Philistia kumpipate na hihlungkim louhlouhna ding in kik inla, lungkimtak in pai in," achi hi.

David in Akish kiang ah, "Ahihleh, bang thil ahia ka na hih? Na kiang a ka om sung teng tuni tan in, ka toupa kumpipa melma dou lou a ka kik nawn maimah ding, na sikha tung ah bang mu na hia oi?" achi hi.
Akish in adawng a, David kiang ah, "Ka mitmuh in Pathian angel bang in na hoih chih ka thei hi. Himahleh Philistia kumpipate'n, kidouna ah i kiang ah ahong sam kei ding, achi bikbek mawk uhi.
Huaiziak in na kiang a om na pu sikhate toh zingkhang in thou unla, zingkhang a na thoh phet ua khua avak chiang in pai un," achi hi.
Huchi in David leh amite Philistia gam a kik nawn ding a zingsang a pawtkhe ding in athouta uh. Jezreel ah Philistia mite ahohtou uhi.
